name: StayAwake
description: Keep your screen awake! A web app preventing sleep mode only while this tab is active (foreground). Features draggable & toggleable widgets: Clock ⏰, Battery 🔋, To-Do List ✅, and Pomodoro Timer 🍅. Installable as a PWA and now a browser extension 💡 for persistent background use.

paragraphs: Stay Awake is a simple yet powerful web application designed to prevent your device's screen from automatically going into sleep mode. It's perfect for situations where you need your screen to remain active, such as reading long articles, monitoring dashboards, or giving a presentation.
Beyond its core functionality as a web app, Stay Awake is also available as a Browser Extension, offering a more powerful and persistent way to keep your screen on without needing to keep a tab open.
ℹ️ Note: The app relies on the Screen Wake Lock API or fallback methods, which require the browser tab to remain in the foreground to be effective.
features: ⏰Digital Clock: Keep track of the current time and date.
🔋Battery Status: Monitor your device's battery level and charging status (requires browser support).
✅To-Do List: Jot down quick tasks and manage them directly within the app.
🍅Pomodoro Timer: Implement the Pomodoro Technique for focused work sessions and breaks.
